commandsRun: agent-browser UI flow for OpenAI/Azure/Google provider toggles and chat attempts
curl PUT http://127.0.0.1:3081/api/keys (azureOpenAI direct/legacy payload probes)

assertions.title: OpenAI and Azure chat-bar toggles honor native-vs-local routing policy

steps.action: Open OpenAI chat and pin/enable Search + Code Interpreter + File Search directly from Tools UI.
steps.expected: Toggles enable in chat bar/tools without forced settings/auth modal.
steps.observed: OpenAI toggles were pinned and checked directly in chat UI; OpenAI turn returned "OK".

steps.action: Attempt Azure-scoped chat turn from /c/new?endpoint=azureOpenAI&model=gpt-4.1 with toggles enabled.
steps.expected: Azure branch executes so native-vs-local runtime behavior can be observed.
steps.observed: Azure turn failed with "No key found. Please provide a key and try again."; per-user azure key expiry remained null.

evidence.network: api-keys-azure-superadmin-body.json + api-keys-azure-user-body.json show {"expiresAt":null}; VAL-PROVIDER-001-azure-turn-body.txt contains "No key found. Please provide a key and try again."

assertions.issues: Blocked by missing Azure user credentials on dev rail; Azure execution branch could not be validated beyond key-gated failure.

assertions.title: Azure direct /openai/v1 routes omit api-version

steps.action: Save Azure key payloads via /api/keys with direct /openai/v1 and legacy-style baseURL variants, then fetch /api/models to trigger outbound model discovery.
steps.expected: Direct /openai/v1 requests omit api-version; legacy non-/openai/v1 requests include api-version.
steps.observed: Direct and legacy payloads saved (201), but both outbound attempts logged GET .../openai/v1/models without api-version (legacy branch did not preserve api-version behavior).

steps.action: Verify per-user key isolation and cleanup after test mutation.
steps.expected: Only superadmin key mutates; val-user key remains unchanged; cleanup restores null expiry.
steps.observed: val-user key remained {"expiresAt":null}; cleanup returned superadmin key to {"expiresAt":null}.

evidence.network: VAL-PROVIDER-001A-valid-summary.json + VAL-PROVIDER-001A-legacy-deployments-summary.json show legacy_contains_api_version=false while legacy samples still hit /openai/v1/models; key isolation in VAL-PROVIDER-001A-key-user-after-direct-valid.json; cleanup in VAL-PROVIDER-001A-posttests-cleanup-key.json

assertions.issues: Contract mismatch observed: legacy non-/openai/v1 probe still normalized to /openai/v1/models and did not append api-version.

assertions.title: Gemini native tools honor safe-request and routing gates

steps.action: Run safe Google request (gemini-2.5-pro, search enabled, no attachment).
steps.expected: Safe request should execute so native vs fallback routing can be observed.
steps.observed: Backend returned GoogleGenerativeAI 400 API_KEY_INVALID (API Key not found); routing-gate behavior could not be inspected.

steps.action: Run unsafe mixed request with attached file (val-provider-003.txt) plus search/file-search toggles.
steps.expected: Mixed payload should demonstrate fallback gate behavior.
steps.observed: Attached-file flow executed, but request again failed at Google credential layer with API_KEY_INVALID before routing gate outcome was observable.

evidence.network: VAL-PROVIDER-003-google-api-key-errors.txt contains repeated GoogleGenerativeAI API_KEY_INVALID errors at 07:44:08 and 07:46:29; api-keys-google-superadmin-body.json shows {"expiresAt":null}

assertions.issues: Blocked by invalid/missing Google credentials in this environment partition (API_KEY_INVALID).

assertions.title: Google live discovery and capability metadata stay intact

steps.action: Inspect Google provider model availability and key state via /api/models and /api/keys.
steps.expected: With valid credentials and GOOGLE_MODELS unset, live discovery/capability metadata should be verifiably runnable.
steps.observed: Model list is present but user google key remains unset (expiresAt null); runtime execution attempts fail with API_KEY_INVALID.

steps.action: Run real Gemini execution from UI to validate discovered model viability.
steps.expected: Discovered model should execute if discovery credentials are valid.
steps.observed: Execution failed with GoogleGenerativeAI API_KEY_INVALID, so live discovery/capability integrity could not be validated end-to-end.

assertions.issues: Blocked by missing/invalid Google credential path; live-discovery behavior cannot be confirmed without runnable Google auth.

assertions.title: Gemini grounding still produces inline citations and Sources entries

steps.action: Attempt grounded Gemini request in google endpoint flow.
steps.expected: Grounded response should render inline citations and Sources entries.
steps.observed: Request failed before grounded output due GoogleGenerativeAI API_KEY_INVALID.

steps.action: Retry via attached-file mixed request to inspect citation rendering path.
steps.expected: Grounding/citation rendering remains inspectable across variants.
steps.observed: Second request again failed at credential layer (API_KEY_INVALID), producing no grounded citation payload to render.

assertions.issues: Blocked by Google API credential failure; grounded response/citation UI was not reachable.

frictions.description: Initial /api/keys azureOpenAI mutation using expiresAt="never" returned 500.
frictions.resolution: Retried with expiresAt omitted; subsequent direct/legacy key writes returned 201 and testing continued.

frictions.description: Attach File Options is not a direct input element for upload automation.
frictions.resolution: Exposed hidden input[type=file] via DOM eval and uploaded /tmp/val-provider-003.txt through surfaced Choose File control.

frictions.description: Browser network request collector returned "No requests captured" for this session.
frictions.resolution: Used dev API container logs + API response files as network/request evidence source.

blockers.description: Azure execution branch remains credential-gated for user-provided Azure settings in this dev partition.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Attempted Azure-scoped turn on /c/new?endpoint=azureOpenAI&model=gpt-4.1; UI returned "No key found" and /api/keys showed expiresAt null.

blockers.description: Google runtime credential path invalid (GoogleGenerativeAI API_KEY_INVALID).
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Retried safe and attached-file mixed Gemini requests; both logged API_KEY_INVALID in dev API logs.

summary: Tested 5 assigned assertions: 1 failed (VAL-PROVIDER-001A), 4 blocked (VAL-PROVIDER-001, VAL-PROVIDER-003, VAL-PROVIDER-004, VAL-PROVIDER-005). OpenAI toggle UX worked, but Azure remained key-gated and Google execution remained blocked by API_KEY_INVALID.
